brief: The ultimate guide to product launches — 6 channels that move the needle.

slots.title: Owned Audience First
slots.body: Your email list is the only platform you truly control. Segment early access and VIP tiers to build anticipation before the public reveal.
slots.calloutBody: Direct reach avoids algorithm limits and converts forty percent higher than social.

slots.title: Native Storytelling
slots.body: Tease the problem your product solves using behind-the-scenes clips and countdown stickers. Platform-native content feels authentic, not salesy.
slots.calloutBody: Stories and reels trigger curiosity loops that drive pre-launch waitlists.

slots.title: Precision Retargeting
slots.body: Run warm traffic to landing pages two weeks before launch. Retarget engaged visitors with social proof and scarcity-driven creative.
slots.calloutBody: Paid spend amplifies momentum only after organic interest is validated.

slots.title: Borrowed Trust
slots.body: Partner with niche creators who already speak to your ideal buyer. Whitelisted creator ads outperform branded creative by threefold.
slots.calloutBody: Audiences trust peer recommendations over polished corporate messaging.

slots.title: Searchable Momentum
slots.body: Publish comparison guides and use-case articles targeting high-intent keywords. Evergreen content captures demand long after launch day ends.
slots.calloutBody: SEO compounds over time, reducing your customer acquisition cost.

slots.title: Exclusive Access
slots.body: Launch inside Slack groups, Discord servers, and niche forums where your power users already gather. Early adopters become vocal advocates.
slots.calloutBody: Community-driven launches generate the highest word-of-mouth velocity.

slots.body: Pick two channels from this guide and map them to your next launch calendar. Start building momentum today, not tomorrow.
